notes: EBIT is proxied by GAAP Operating income for each historical year. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/820313/000110465926013549/aph-20251231x10k.htm))

D&A and capex come directly from the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows (Depreciation and amortization; Capital expenditures). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/820313/000110465926013549/aph-20251231x10k.htm))

NWC definition (absolute, $): (Total current assets - cash & cash equivalents - short-term investments) - (Total current liabilities - current portion of long-term debt). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/820313/000110465926013549/aph-20251231x10k.htm))

Tax_rate uses FY2025 GAAP effective tax rate of 23.1% as the anchor; set to 0.21 for base-case normalization given discrete items. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/820313/000110465926013549/aph-20251231x10k.htm))

Balance-sheet net debt inputs: cash = cash & cash equivalents; investments = short-term investments; debt = current portion of long-term debt + long-term debt (less current portion). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/820313/000110465926013549/aph-20251231x10k.htm))
Comps forward multiples (EV/NTM revenue, EV/NTM EBITDA, P/E NTM) were not populated with citable forward-data sources within this run; comps metrics are left null by design.

catalysts: CCS integration and margin trajectory updates (CCS sales contribution and incremental EPS accretion). ([investors.amphenol.com](https://investors.amphenol.com/news-and-events/news-details/2026/Amphenol-Reports-Record-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

Additional acquisition announcements/closures and any changes to the implied growth runway in 2026-2027. ([investors.amphenol.com](https://investors.amphenol.com/news-and-events/news-details/2026/Amphenol-Reports-Record-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

Quarterly evidence of sustained IT/datacom and adjacent demand strength versus normalization in other end markets. ([investors.amphenol.com](https://investors.amphenol.com/news-and-events/news-details/2026/Amphenol-Reports-Record-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))
company_overview: Amphenol is a global designer/manufacturer of electrical/electronic and fiber-optic connectors, interconnect systems, antennas, sensors, and specialty cable (USD reporting; majority of sales outside the U.S.). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/820313/000110465926013549/aph-20251231x10k.htm))

Business is organized into three reportable segments: Communications Solutions, Harsh Environment Solutions, and Interconnect and Sensor Systems. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/820313/000110465926013549/aph-20251231x10k.htm))

End markets include IT/datacom and communications, industrial and automotive applications, and defense/commercial aerospace. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/820313/000110465926013549/aph-20251231x10k.htm))
current_context: FY2025: sales of $23.1 billion (+52% in U.S. dollars; +38% organically) with GAAP operating margin of 25.4% and GAAP operating and free cash flow of $5.4B and $4.4B. ([investors.amphenol.com](https://investors.amphenol.com/news-and-events/news-details/2026/Amphenol-Reports-Record-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

CCS acquisition: closed in January 2026; management expects full-year 2026 CCS sales of approximately $4.1 billion and incremental contribution of approximately $0.15 to 2026 adjusted diluted EPS. ([investors.amphenol.com](https://investors.amphenol.com/news-and-events/news-details/2026/Amphenol-Reports-Record-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

Q1 2026 outlook: sales expected $6.90B to $7.00B and adjusted diluted EPS expected $0.91 to $0.93. ([investors.amphenol.com](https://investors.amphenol.com/news-and-events/news-details/2026/Amphenol-Reports-Record-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))
investment_highlights: Base-case revenue growth explicitly incorporates continued contribution from the CCS acquisition and re-acceleration/normalization in the core base after the FY2025 acquisition-driven step-up. ([investors.amphenol.com](https://investors.amphenol.com/news-and-events/news-details/2026/Amphenol-Reports-Record-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))

Profitability thesis is grounded in recent operating performance (FY2025 operating margin 25.4%) and assumes modest margin stabilization/normalization toward a ~24-25% EBIT margin range. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/820313/000110465926013549/aph-20251231x10k.htm))

Capital intensity remains consistent with historical cash flow patterns: forecast D&A and capex ratios are set close to recent FY levels (roughly high-single to low-mid single digit % of revenue). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/820313/000110465926013549/aph-20251231x10k.htm))

Working capital is modeled to partially normalize from the FY2025 level, using a transparent NWC% construction based on current asset/cash/investment and current liability/current-debt components. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/820313/000110465926013549/aph-20251231x10k.htm))
key_risks: Integration/mix risk: acquired businesses may operate below the company’s average operating margin, pressuring consolidated profitability. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/820313/000110465926013549/aph-20251231x10k.htm))

Working capital volatility (receivables/inventory/payables dynamics) could differ materially from forecast NWC% of sales. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/820313/000110465926013549/aph-20251231x10k.htm))

Effective tax rate volatility due to discrete/non-recurring tax items can affect earnings power and cash tax assumptions. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/820313/000110465926013549/aph-20251231x10k.htm))

valuation_summary: DCF base case links revenue growth, EBIT margin, D&A, capex, and NWC% to historical GAAP relationships (Operating income as EBIT; cash flow line items for D&A and capex; constructed NWC from balance-sheet current items). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/820313/000110465926013549/aph-20251231x10k.htm))

Terminal assumptions use conservative long-run economics (terminal growth 0.02; exit EBITDA multiple 16.0) consistent with a mature, diversified electronics component supplier. ([investors.amphenol.com](https://investors.amphenol.com/news-and-events/news-details/2026/Amphenol-Reports-Record-Fourth-Quarter-and-Full-Year-2025-Results/default.aspx))
